translationRepairs: Zhang Shoupeng, the Tai'an assistant prefect, should have been demoted, but Xie Tingcai of the Bureau of Appointments posted him as Yongping investigating censor on the pretext that a sixth-rank assistant prefect could be shifted to a seventh-rank investigating post.

Zhang Shoupeng, the Tai'an assistant prefect, should have been demoted, but Xie Tingcai of the Bureau of Appointments posted him as Yongping prefectural judge on the pretext that a sixth-rank assistant prefect could be shifted to a seventh-rank judgeship.
推官 is a prefectural judge, not a censor. 推官 is a judge.
Wu Ding, Minister of Punishments, memorialized in his defense.
Wu Ding, Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, memorialized in his defense.
大理卿 heads the Court of Judicial Review.
Under the Tianqi emperor he was posthumously made Grand Master of Imperial Sacrifices.
Under the Tianqi emperor he was posthumously made Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
太常卿 is chief minister of the court.
He served as investigating censor in Jianchang and Quzhou in turn, then entered the Court of Punishments as a reviewing official.
He served as prefectural judge in Jianchang and Quzhou in turn, then entered the Court of Judicial Review as a case reviewer.
推官 is a prefectural judge. 大理評事 belongs to the Court of Judicial Review.
He rose through the Ministry of Punishments, became prefect of Quanzhou, and was promoted to Guangdong vice commissioner, earning a strong reputation at each post.
He served as vice director in the Ministry of Punishments, became prefect of Quanzhou, and was promoted to Guangdong vice commissioner, earning a strong reputation at each post.
刑部員外 is a vice director.
The emperor was furious and demoted him three ranks to Guangxi commissioner.
The emperor was furious and demoted him three ranks to Guangxi assistant surveillance commissioner.
僉事 is an assistant surveillance commissioner.
The Liaodong governor-general and censor, and Shanhai registrar Wu Zhongying, protested in turn.
The Liaodong grand coordinator and regional inspector, and Shanhai secretary Wu Zhongying, protested in turn.
撫按 are grand coordinator and regional inspector; 主事 is a secretary.
Years later he was made Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Jiangxi.
Years later he was made Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Jiangxi.
右僉都御史 is assistant censor-in-chief.
The following year he memorialized against the Huguang tax agent Chen Feng and pleaded for Vice Commissioner Feng Yingjing.
The following year he memorialized against the Huguang tax agent Chen Feng and pleaded for Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Feng Yingjing.
僉事 is an assistant surveillance commissioner.
Shen Yiguan and others urgently asked to adjourn court and drafted an edict for the provincial authorities, but received no approval.
Shen Yiguan and others urgently asked that Wang Chao be dismissed and drafted an edict for the provincial authorities, but received no approval.
罷朝 here means dismissing Wang Chao (朝).
He served as a director in the Ministry of Revenue.
He served as a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
主事 is a secretary, not a director.
At the start of Tianqi he was first recalled as a director in the Nanjing Ministry of War.
At the start of Tianqi he was first recalled as a secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of War.
主事 is a secretary, not a director.
In year twenty-eight he was made Huguang vice commissioner with touring authority over Wuchang, Hanyang, and Huangzhou.
In year twenty-eight he was made Huguang assistant surveillance commissioner with touring authority over Wuchang, Hanyang, and Huangzhou.
僉事 is an assistant surveillance commissioner.
At the same time Xiangyang assistant prefect Di Zhai, investigating censor He Dongru, and Zaoyang magistrate Wang Zhihan had also crossed Feng and were impeached.
At the same time Xiangyang assistant prefect Di Zhai, prefectural judge He Dongru, and Zaoyang magistrate Wang Zhihan had also crossed Feng and were impeached.
推官 is a prefectural judge.
Soon the Jiangxi tax agent Li Dao also reported Feng's embezzlement; Feng was recalled and his affairs were handed to Chengdu garrison commander Du Mao.
Soon the Jiangxi tax agent Li Dao also reported Feng's embezzlement; Feng was recalled and his affairs were handed to Chengtian garrison commander Du Mao.
承天 is Chengtian, not Chengdu.
He was appointed a reviewing official in the Court of Punishments.
He was appointed a case reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review.
大理評事 is a case reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review.
He was appointed investigating censor of Jingzhou.
He was appointed prefectural judge of Jingzhou.
推官 is a prefectural judge.
Tax agent Chen Feng's servant Puzhi galloped straight into the prefectural office; Yu had him flogged.
Tax agent Chen Feng's servant galloped straight into the prefectural office; Yu had him flogged.
仆直馳 means the servant rode straight in; Puzhi is not a name.
Yu reported Feng to censor Yan Ji for restraint; Feng hated him all the more.
Yu reported to the censor that Feng should be strictly restrained; Feng hated him all the more.
嚴戢 means strictly restrain, not a name.
